svg.aria-label: Interactify CI/CD for the phone: a pull request or push runs build.yaml, which builds and tests the server and client. A push to main also runs deploy.yaml, which builds and tests the server, packs dist.tgz, and copies it over SSH through Cloudflare Access to the phone, where deploy.sh installs it, restarts PM2 and checks /health, rolling back if the check fails.
svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
